items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was Rapolo a reader, too? [INTERVIEWEE] No. No, huh? No, he couldn't read it. No big as a bass player.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Uh-huh. Ten men. They had, oh, Sig had some good men in his band. He had fellas like Bollie DeFoe, Muxi Spania, uh, uh, Bob Buscelli. I haven't heard much of him recently. He, wait, in the last 20 years or so, I think Bob had just wrapped up. He went in for the motion picture business. He didn't care too much about the, uh, music. Shorty Williamson, Georgie Petroni, Earl Andrews. Sig played fiddle. Sig played fiddle, yes. I was with the band, too. Did he double on anything else? No. A good part of the…
No. No, huh? No, he couldn't read it. No big as a bass player.
